label: D2 at S1 after a common a1 choice, following an unrewarded previous trial, while the a1 preference is weak
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2) and only when state S1 is shown: 100% of activation mass is at D2 with in_state=S1, and 98% of it follows an a1 choice (a common transition). It never fires at D1 or GO, at S2, or with reward input 1. Within D2/S1/a1 (recall 0.96, precision 0.21) the activation is gated by an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward=0 holds 91% of mass and nearly all of the top quartile) and by a weak or moderate a1 preference in the policy logit at that step (choice < 3; strongly committed a1 states rarely fire). Combining these gives dev F1 0.57, precision 0.68, mass recall 0.87. Adding value, the hidden good state, or the previous action did not help. Precision is still incomplete: many D2 S1 steps after a loss stay silent, so the feature likely encodes a graded hidden-state quantity (S1 reached via a1 after a loss, while the agent is still uncertain), not a crisp event. All variables used are observable at D2 or are the model's own output.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & last=a1 S1 u (+8.30), phase=D2 & this=a1 S1 (+3.35), phase=D2 & last=a2 S1 u (+2.02), phase=D2 & before=a1 S1 u (+1.88), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 7 (9 = most a1) (+1.80), next_stay=0 (+1.20).
